source: Indian states and districts as listed on igod.gov.in, via github.com/KTBsomen/Indian-state-district-json (downloaded 2026-10-26). Cleaned: capitalisation of 'and'/'of', NTR, Leh, Lakshadweep; Mahe and Yanam added to Puducherry; Odisha's districts given their English names (Cuttack, Angul, Bargarh…); East Singhbhum, Mauganj, SAS Nagar (Mohali) spelled out. GST codes are the GSTIN state codes. Cities: the 1-lakh-plus cities of the 2011 Census via github.com/recurze/IndianCities, mapped onto today's districts (a city that shares a district's name goes there; renamed districts are followed; a city that cannot be placed keeps no district). Census names updated to today's (Mysuru, Prayagraj, Gurugram…); capitals and main towns under the 1-lakh line added for every state.
